lines.text: How do you survive... the Pale Stretcher?
It's two A.M., and your car dies on an empty forest road.
Then, far down the road, in the fog...
It's nine feet tall, with arms that hang down to its knees.
Rule number one: never look at its face.
If you see it, it screams...
and it runs at you. It never stops.
Now it's walking toward your car.
Run into the woods? No. With those legs, it catches you in seconds.
Lock the doors? If it's hunting you, glass won't stop it.
Here's what works. Lights off, cover your eyes, and slide down into the footwell.
Bare feet on the asphalt... right next to your door.
Long fingers tap on the window.
Don't move. Don't breathe. And don't open your eyes.
Because it's waiting for you to look.
Keep them shut until sunrise. At dawn, it's gone.
Would you have survived? Follow, because part four is coming for you.
